assumptions: The Python version is not stated in the context; no python_version is set, so the harness default is used.
No numpy or other era pin is required for these sympy polys/matrices tests; pins are left empty.
sympy is pure Python, so the 'native_library_failure' diagnosis does not apply to a compiled build; the recipe is 'pure' rather than 'compiled'.
The PR date is null, so no date-based era pin was chosen.
The buggy-side failure is assumed to be an assertion on the nan/zero value, which is the reported wrong-value manifestation.

Run the SDM test cases on the fixed revision; expected to PASS.
